A mis-fortune from The Mighty Zoltan (14.x: A mis-fortune from The Mighty Zoltan (14/17) is one of the 17 mis-fortunes granted by The Mighty Zoltan at the Spring Fayre.

sc: A red Agility tome is an experience reward from the minigame, Temple Trekking.
There are six artefacts, all of which are obtained during the first stage of the quest by using a trowel on an artefact in the unfinished train tunnel in Dorgesh-Kaan.
The augmented chaotic spear is a level 80 Melee two-handed weapon created by using an augmentor on a chaotic spear.
An augmented Deathdealer robe bottom is armour created by using an augmentor on a tier 70 deathdealer robe bottom.
Augmented Obliteration is a tier 87 two-handed magic weapon created by using an augmentor on Obliteration.

sc: A beach armour override token is an item that could originally be obtained through The Beach (2018).
The black prism is an item used during the Zogre Flesh Eaters quest which can be found by searching the ogre coffin in the northwesternmost room of the cave in Jiggig Dungeon.
If the black prism is lost, it can be found again by searching the ogre coffin it was originally found in during the quest.
The blue corner key is a key found in Daemonheim while training the Dungeoneering skill.
Only one blue corner key can be found in a single dungeon.
It is made by using class 1 sacred clay on a creation kiln.
Brawling gloves (Prayer) (also known as Prayer brawling gloves) are obtained as a rare drop from revenants in the Forinthry Dungeon, the Wilderness shared loot table and the Chaos Elemental.
Opening a sack of very wild rewards has a very high chance of obtaining brawling gloves, but it is no longer obtainable.
It can be made at a forge and anvil using 20 elder rune bars and an elder rune platebody + 2, requiring 6,000 progress to complete, granting a total of 20,000 Smithing experience.
It can be made at a forge and anvil using 4 primal bars and a primal 2h sword, requiring 3,520 progress to complete, granting a total of 5,600 Smithing experience.
It is found in the room before Ava's room in Draynor Manor, behind a book called The Blind Forest.
It is made by using a piece of charcoal on a sheet of papyrus while standing on the west side of the castle at the north end of Meiyerditch.

Circus (Ringmaster).x: The Circus (Ringmaster) outfit is a cosmetic override set that can be unlocked by participating in Balthazar Beauregard's Big Top Bonanza. Each piece of the override set is unlocked when its corresponding item from the Ringmaster outfit is obtained.

sc: Clue scroll (easy) is a simple clue obtained from easy sealed clue scrolls.
Clue scroll (master) is an anagram clue obtained from master sealed clue scrolls.

Construct of Justice Chestplate.x: Construct of Justice Chestplate is a recolourable torso slot cosmetic override that is part of the Construct of Justice outfit.

sc: The Corruption Orb was an item available in the T95 Magic Dual Wield beta.
A Cosy Earmuffs (Zamorak) Token (Untradeable) is an item that can be obtained from Purple Christmas Presents from the 2024 Christmas event onward.
It can be redeemed to unlock the Cosy Earmuffs (Zamorak) cosmetic override, destroying the token in the process.
The dark gloves is a rare prize from Treasure Hunter and is part of the Dark outfit.
Dark Romancer Attire is a cosmetic override outfit that can be unlocked through the Gifts from the Heart promotion from Treasure Hunter.
Dragon metal is an Archaeological material that can be obtained through excavating material caches or various excavation sites, requiring level 73 Archaeology, at various dig sites around RuneScape.
The barrows-dyed drygore rapier is made by dyeing a drygore rapier with Barrows dye.
Currently, the cost of a full repair using chitin scraps if purchased from the Grand Exchange would be .
It is made by imbuing a bogolin stick with 5,000 earth runes with level 52 Runecrafting.
It can be created by combining a crossbow string with an unstrung elder crossbow, requiring level 93 Fletching and yielding 71.

Elf-style boots (red).x: The red elf-style boots are part of the elven outfit item set. They give no bonuses and are a cosmetic item.

sc: It can be created with level 100 Runecrafting by imbuing an eternal magic orb (moderate) with pure essence or rune essence at most runecrafting altars.
It can be created with level 100 Runecrafting by imbuing an eternal magic wand (inert) with pure essence or rune essence at most runecrafting altars.

Fae Fairy Claw.x: Fae Fairy Claw is a main hand melee weapon cosmetic override that can be unlocked by purchasing the Fae Light Melee Weapon Pack.

sc: The fishing jacket is a reward item from the Fish Flingers Distraction and Diversion that can be bought with 140 fishing tokens.
It was made by combining a green charm with 130 spirit shards and a Banana.

Spirit gems, which are dropped by all monsters that drop a single charm and could be received from the Squeal of Fortune, functioned similarly to Runecrafting pouches and stored uncharged summoning pouches before an update.
The godsword shard 1 is a drop from the bosses and sub-bosses in the God Wars Dungeon.

The sketch is not required, but without it, there is a failure chance.
sc: Vaguely yet obviously described by Gujuo, the required vessel is a bowl "made from the metal of the sun".

It is made by using two gold bars on an anvil while holding the sketch given to the player by Gujuo; after completion of the quest, it is possible to make the bowl without the sketch, though there remains a chance of failing.
The gold crescent key is a key found in Daemonheim while training the Dungeoneering skill.
Only one gold crescent key can be found in a single dungeon.

tx:
• Burying bones or scattering demonic ashes
• Burying bones with the bonecrusher
• Offering bones or ashes to a player-owned house altar
• Offering bones or ashes to the altar at the chaos temple (in the Wilderness)
• Offering bones or ashes to the altar at Fort Forinthry
• Teleporting completed urns
• Worshipping the ectofuntus
Since bones buried by the bonecrusher count, prayer rocks can be gained at the same time as the combat and slayer rocks. Consuming bones while wearing bone necklaces also works.
Offering bones at the chaos temple's altar can be convenient as it is close the Wilderness Crater lodestone and the Wilderness swords offer a quick teleport to near Edgeville bank. Furthermore, plenty of bones are scattered around the altar and respawn quickly.
The following methods do not yield any golden rocks:
• Cremation
• Using cleansing crystals at the Corrupted Seren Stone in the Hefin Cathedral

sc: A grimy marrentill is a herb dropped by various monsters or harvested from a marrentill plant grown from a marrentill seed in a herb patch, requiring level 14 Farming.

Group Ironman platebody 1.x: Group Ironman platebody 1 is a torso slot cosmetic override that is part of the Group Ironman armour 1.

sc: The hand of glory (Kharid-et) is the hand with third-lowest Archaeology requirement and can be found at the Kharid-et Dig Site on the Orcus altar behind the pontifex barrier, requiring the pontifex signet ring to enter.
To re-obtain if lost, the player can either talk to the workers or search the crates in the Tower.
Hard hat.x: The hard hat is a members only helmet used in the Tower of Life quest to gain access to the tower. You can also talk to 'Black-eye' and answer a few questions to obtain another one if lost.

sc: It is found in the cupboard in the Hide and Seek staging area of the secret bunker.
Holy biscuits are a stackable food that can be obtained from all levels of Treasure Trails, though higher level Treasure Trails yield greater amounts at a time.
These are not tradeable, and are normally only obtainable through Treasure Trails, with a 400 maximum that can be obtained.
It's made by using the attack hood on the attack cape, which can be reversed with the right-click "Detach" option.
The hooded master max cape is obtained by combining a master max cape with a master max hood.
The cape and hood are sold by Minerva in Falador for 3,480,000 coins, which is 120,000 coins times , the number of skills.
The jade idol body was a common reward from the Squeal of Fortune.

K'ril's Godcrusher Chest Armour.x: K'ril's Godcrusher Chest Armour is a torso slot cosmetic override that can be unlocked by purchasing the K'ril's Godcrusher outfit.

sc: The laboratory relic (common) is a relic obtainable from the Dragonkin Laboratory.
The list is a quest item given to the player by Queen Ellamaria at the start of the Garden of Tranquillity quest.
The seeds are given to the player by various NPCs after performing tasks during the quest.

Lunarlight Bow.x: The Lunarlight Bow is a two-handed ranged weapon cosmetic override that can be obtained by purchasing the Lunarlight Weapon bundle.

Manticore Halberd.x: Manticore Halberd is a two-handed melee weapon cosmetic override that can be unlocked by purchasing the Manticore Melee Weapon Pack.

sc: It was temporarily available from Treasure Hunter from 17 November 2020 to 23 November 2020 as part of the Dressed to Skill promotion.
It can be made at a forge and anvil using 2 mithril bars, requiring 800 progress to complete, granting a total of 240 Smithing experience.
When dropped by a monster, it will be treated like small bladed mithril salvage by the spring cleaner.
It can be made at a forge and anvil using 2 mithril bars and a mithril sword, requiring 640 progress to complete, granting a total of 240 Smithing experience.
The monkey skull is a very rare item that may be obtained by looting zombie implings and zombie impling jars, with a drop rate of 1/3,000.
The skull can be seen in a room with Monkey Zombies in the Temple of Marimbo Dungeon on Ape Atoll, but it is impossible to obtain from there because a locked door prevents access.

Musketeer's hat (blue, male).x: The blue musketeer's hat is part of the musketeer outfit item set. It gives no bonuses and is a cosmetic item.

Necturion (Masterwork) Off-hand Scimitar.x: The Necturion (Masterwork) Off-hand Scimitar is an off-hand melee weapon cosmetic override that is part of the Necturion (Masterwork) Outfit. Along with the rest of the outfit, it can be unlocked by spending 100% respect in the Artisans' Workshop.

sc: The NovtumberFest Gingerbread Necklace is unlocked by claiming a gingerbread necklace token.
The Omni guard is a main-hand Necromancy siphon dropped by Rasial, the First Necromancer.

sc: Papyrus can be found by searching the tall shelves of the house in Past A during the Meeting History quest.

The peppermint gloves are a hands slot item that are part of the peppermint outfit given as a reward from being on Santa's nice list during the 2023 Christmas event on any week starting from 3 December.
An empty plant pot may be created with the Crafting skill at level 19 by using a soft clay on a potter's wheel, which creates an unfired plant pot.
With filled plant pots available from farming shops for the same price as empty plant pots, most players simply discard empties on use.
It can be purchased for 8500 Teci (rewarded for completing Liberation of Mazcab) from the Armoursmith in Mazcab.

It is made by combining a super ranging potion (4) and an extreme ranging (4) in a crystal flask, giving 217.
